gist.summary: Refreshed the app catalog's daily request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json. The updated requests24h values reflect a new rolling 24-hour window; this does not add or change an app.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden shed, Polli checks a retro monitor showing changing app-request counters beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny reading glasses and stays small within the scene. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
